description: Multilingual audio/video transcription PWA with Telegram bot

layers.label: Shared Library
layers.description: Business logic shared between web and bot

modules.label: Home Page
modules.description: Server Component. Fetches user profile, credits, and telegram_accounts (via adminClient). Renders HomeContent + Telegram promo card (hidden if already connected).

modules.label: HomeContent
modules.description: Client Component. Toggle between Upload and Record modes. Passes recorded File as initialFile to UploadZone.

modules.label: UploadZone
modules.description: Client Component. Drag-drop or file picker. Detects duration via HTMLVideoElement, calls /api/credits check, uploads via XHR with progress, receives {id}. Accepts initialFile prop from RecordZone.

modules.label: RecordZone
modules.description: Client Component. Cross-browser audio recording via MediaRecorder API. Codec priority: webm+opus → webm → mp4 → ogg. On stop emits File to HomeContent.

modules.label: Transcription Page
modules.description: Client Component. Polls GET /api/transcribe/[id] every 5s until done/error. Shows Text / Timestamps / Summary tabs. On-demand summary translation via POST /api/transcribe/[id]/summary.

modules.label: History Page
modules.description: Server Component. Protected — redirects to /login if no session. Lists transcriptions ordered by created_at desc.

modules.label: Billing Page
modules.description: Server Component. Shows credit balance and Telegram link status via TelegramLinkButton.

modules.label: Connect Telegram
modules.description: Server Component. Feature highlights + TelegramLinkButton. Checks if already linked via adminClient.

modules.label: Login Page
modules.description: Client Component. Calls Supabase signInWithOAuth (Google) with prompt=select_account to prevent auto-login in PWA.

modules.label: POST /api/transcribe
modules.description: Validates MIME type (strips codec params), checks file size (500MB), resolves Gladia key via api-keys.ts, reserves credits, uploads to Gladia, starts transcription job, saves DB record with status=processing.

modules.label: GET /api/transcribe/[id]
modules.description: Owner-check (returns 404 not 403 if wrong user). Polls Gladia once. On done: finaliseGladiaResult → update DB → adjustCredits. Returns stored result if already done.

modules.label: POST /api/transcribe/[id]/summary
modules.description: Regenerates summary via Groq in requested language. Not cached to DB — on-demand only.

modules.label: GET /api/credits
modules.description: Returns {sufficient, remaining} for current user (cookie session) or anonymous IP. Used by UploadZone before upload.

modules.label: POST /api/telegram/webhook
modules.description: Responds 200 immediately, runs processUpdate async (Telegram requires <5s). Handles messages (audio/voice/video) and callback_query (sum/trs/trl actions). callback_query verifies telegram_id → supabase_user_id ownership before returning transcript data. lang validated against whitelist. stripMarkdown() before sending summary.

modules.label: /api/telegram/connect
modules.description: POST: generates one-time deep link token (15min TTL) stored in telegram_link_tokens. DELETE: unlinks account.

modules.label: GET /auth/callback
modules.description: OAuth callback handler. Exchanges code for session via Supabase, redirects to home.

modules.label: transcription.ts
modules.description: Single pipeline for both web and bot. processFile() (bot: full sync) and finaliseGladiaResult() (web: after Gladia done). Both call addSummary→summariseTranscript. formatTranscriptText() skips speaker labels if only one speaker.

modules.label: gladia.ts
modules.description: Gladia API v2 client. uploadAudio, startTranscription, checkTranscriptionStatus (one call), pollTranscription (loop, 5s interval, max 60 attempts). All functions accept apiKey param — no direct env reads.

modules.label: groq.ts
modules.description: Groq API client. summariseTranscript(text, language, apiKey) and translateTranscript(text, targetLang, apiKey). Model: llama-3.3-70b-versatile.

modules.label: credits.ts
modules.description: CreditSubject = user|anon. Atomic Postgres RPCs: reserveCredits, adjustCredits (post-Gladia correction), refundCredits (on error). Anonymous limit: 180s by IP.

modules.label: api-keys.ts
modules.description: resolveGladiaKey(userId) and resolveGroqKey(userId). OWNER_USER_ID env → personal keys. Others → *_PUBLIC keys (fallback to owner keys if not set).

modules.label: telegram.ts
modules.description: Telegram Bot API helpers. sendMessage, sendTextOrFile (splits to file if >4096 chars), answerCallbackQuery, getFileInfo, downloadFile. getTranslateLabel / getTargetLang for i18n buttons.

modules.label: profiles
modules.description: id, email, display_name, credits_seconds (default 1200), is_unlimited (default false), created_at.

modules.label: transcriptions
modules.description: id, user_id (nullable), file_name, file_url, duration_seconds, language, status, result (jsonb), gladia_result_url, reserved_seconds, created_at.

modules.label: anonymous_usage
modules.description: ip (PK), used_seconds, updated_at. RLS: IP can only read/write own row.

modules.label: telegram_accounts
modules.description: telegram_id (PK), supabase_user_id, telegram_username, created_at. Requires adminClient — RLS blocks user client.

modules.label: telegram_link_tokens
modules.description: token (PK), supabase_user_id, expires_at (15min), used bool, created_at.

external_services.label: Gladia API v2
external_services.description: Async transcription with speaker diarization. 100+ languages. Upload → start job → poll result_url.

external_services.label: Groq API
external_services.description: LLM inference. Model: llama-3.3-70b-versatile. Used for summary generation and translation.

external_services.label: Telegram Bot API
external_services.description: Webhook-based bot. Sends messages, inline keyboards, documents. Bot: @TranscriboAppBot.

external_services.label: Google OAuth
external_services.description: OAuth 2.0 provider via Supabase Auth. prompt=select_account prevents auto-login in PWA.

external_services.label: Supabase
external_services.description: Postgres + Auth + RLS. Two clients: user (RLS-scoped) and admin (service_role, bypasses RLS).

flows.label: Web: File Upload
flows.description: User uploads audio/video via browser. Credit check → Gladia async job → 5s polling → summary.

flows.label: Web: Browser Recording
flows.description: User records audio in browser via MediaRecorder API. Codec auto-detected. Recorded file flows into upload pipeline.

flows.label: Telegram: Bot Transcription
flows.description: User sends audio to @TranscriboAppBot. Webhook responds immediately, processes async. Full sync pipeline in processFile().

flows.label: Auth: Google Sign-In
flows.description: Google OAuth via Supabase. prompt=select_account prevents PWA auto-login with previous account.

flows.label: Telegram: Account Linking
flows.description: One-time deep link generated on website, opened in Telegram. Bot handles /start link_TOKEN and upserts telegram_accounts.

flows.label: Credits: Reserve → Adjust
flows.description: Atomic Postgres RPCs. Reserve estimate before upload, adjust to actual Gladia duration after done, refund on error.
